protocolDescription: Funnel-shaped net mounted on a car roof: front 75 cm high x 100 cm wide, 140 cm long, detachable sampling bag (29 cm wide) at the rear; mesh ~0.3 mm, 2 x 1 mm on the grey bottom fabric. A manually designed 5 km route is driven from start to end and back to the start at no more than 50 km/h, once between 12:00 and 15:00 and once between 17:00 and 20:00 on the same day, at 15 °C or more, average wind no more than 6 m/s and no rain. Each drive's sampling bag is placed in 96% ethanol and later stored at -20 °C.

protocolName: Route land cover and region classification
protocolDescription: Derived by the researchers from GIS data, not observed in the field: dominant land cover along the route (farmland, forest or urban if 50% or more, otherwise mixed) and biogeographic region.

protocolName: Taxonomic assignment with the GBIF sequence ID tool
protocolDescription: BLAST against a 99% clustered version of the BOLD Public Database (COI-5P). Match types: exact (identity >= 99%, query coverage >= 80%), ambiguous (exact, but with another match of similar identity), close (identity 90-99%), weak (identity < 90% or coverage < 80%), none.
